intro-one: A letter turns up. You read it three times and still can't say what it wants from you. A builder quotes you a number and you've no idea whether it's fair. Your energy bill doubles and the explanation runs to eleven pages.

intro-two: You could do any of it. You just don't know where to start, or how long it takes if you do. From the outside, twenty minutes and a whole Saturday look the same. So it stays on the list.
